age_limit.details: Clinical Psychologist: Maximum age limit is 45 years. Consultant Counsellor: Maximum age limit is 40 years.

qualification.details: Clinical Psychologist: B.A. (Hons)/B.Sc. and M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology with at least 55% marks from a recognized University/Institute. At least 2 year's experience in Adult & Adolescence Mental Health. Consultant Counsellor: B.A. (Hons)/B.Sc. and M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology with at least 55% marks from a recognized University/Institute. At least 2 year's experience in Adult & Adolescence Mental Health.

salary_details.pay_scale: Clinical Psychologist: Rs. 80,000/- to Rs. 1,10,000/- (Per month), Consultant Counsellor: Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- (Per month)

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Delhi to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Clinical Psychologist and Male Counsellor posts is 22 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Clinical Psychologist post?
faq.answer: For the Clinical Psychologist post, candidates need a B.A. (Hons)/B.Sc. and M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology with an M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology, securing at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Consultant Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant Counsellor position is 40 years. There are no minimum age requirements specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Clinical Psychologist post?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Clinical Psychologist post in the IIT Delhi recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Clinical Psychologist role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Clinical Psychologist post ranges from Rs. 80,000/- to Rs. 1,10,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Clinical Psychologist and Male Counsellor posts will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is online. Candidates need to apply through the provided Google Form link or the IRD website.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Delhi offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any such provisions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies in this recruitment?
faq.answer: In total, there are 4 vacancies announced by IIT Delhi for the posts of Clinical Psychologist and Male Counsellor.
